fact: As of 30 June 2026 around 30,400 refugees and asylum-seekers in Benin were individually registered, 16,463 recognized refugees lacked valid refugee identity cards, about 12,400 asylum-seekers were unregistered, and 8,481 had been registered and 2,337 issued protection documents in northern Benin under the COSO project.
title: Fact Sheet - Bénin - January-June 2026
